import math
import unittest

from solution import check_allocation


class CheckAllocationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_allocations_and_input_preservation(self):
        original = [{"id": "a", "spend": 1000}, {"id": ("b", 1), "spend": -200.0}]
        fragments = [
            {"source_id": "a", "spend": 400},
            {"source_id": ("b", 1), "spend": -200},
            {"source_id": "a", "spend": 600.5},
        ]
        original_before = [dict(row) for row in original]
        fragments_before = [dict(row) for row in fragments]
        self.assertIsNone(check_allocation(original, fragments, "spend"))
        self.assertEqual(original, original_before)
        self.assertEqual(fragments, fragments_before)

    def test_empty_inputs_are_valid(self):
        self.assertIsNone(check_allocation([], [], "units"))

    def test_equality_at_nonzero_tolerance_boundary(self):
        self.assertIsNone(
            check_allocation(
                [{"id": 1, "m": 1000}],
                [{"source_id": 1, "m": 1001}],
                "m",
            )
        )
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            check_allocation(
                [{"id": 1, "m": 1000}],
                [{"source_id": 1, "m": 1001.0001}],
                "m",
            )

    def test_zero_tolerance_boundary(self):
        self.assertIsNone(
            check_allocation(
                [{"id": "z", "m": 0}],
                [{"source_id": "z", "m": 1e-12}],
                "m",
            )
        )
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            check_allocation(
                [{"id": "z", "m": 0}],
                [{"source_id": "z", "m": 1.0001e-12}],
                "m",
            )

    def test_missing_coverage_unknown_source_and_bad_total(self):
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            check_allocation([{"id": "a", "m": 1}], [], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            check_allocation([], [{"source_id": "a", "m": 0}], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            check_allocation(
                [{"id": "a", "m": 100}],
                [{"source_id": "a", "m": 99}],
                "m",
            )

    def test_top_level_record_and_metric_type_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            check_allocation((), [], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            check_allocation([], (), "m")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            check_allocation([[]], [], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            check_allocation([], [[]], "m")
        for bad_metric in (None, 3, True):
            with self.subTest(metric=bad_metric):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    check_allocation([], [], bad_metric)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_allocation([], [], "")

    def test_malformed_records_and_duplicate_ids(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_allocation([{"id": "a"}], [], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_allocation([{"id": "a", "m": 1, "extra": 2}], [], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_allocation([], [{"source_id": "a"}], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_allocation([], [{"source_id": "a", "m": 1, "extra": 2}], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_allocation(
                [{"id": "a", "m": 1}, {"id": "a", "m": 1}],
                [{"source_id": "a", "m": 2}],
                "m",
            )

    def test_unhashable_identifiers(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            check_allocation([{"id": [], "m": 1}], [], "m")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            check_allocation([], [{"source_id": {}, "m": 1}], "m")

    def test_metric_values_reject_wrong_types_and_nonfinite_numbers(self):
        for bad in (True, False, None, "1", complex(1, 0)):
            with self.subTest(original_value=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    check_allocation([{"id": "a", "m": bad}], [], "m")
            with self.subTest(fragment_value=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    check_allocation([], [{"source_id": "a", "m": bad}], "m")
        for bad in (math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan):
            with self.subTest(original_value=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    check_allocation([{"id": "a", "m": bad}], [], "m")
            with self.subTest(fragment_value=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    check_allocation([], [{"source_id": "a", "m": bad}], "m")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
